title: first start forces the administrator to pick a new password
the stylesheet is applied, not merely served
the styles survive into the signed-in application
a backup can be created, downloaded and restored from the folder
an unwanted restore can be undone with the before-restore file
the retention period can be changed from the screen
a file that is not a backup is refused without losing any data
a plain user cannot reach the backup screen
the double booking guard blocks a taken slot and can be overridden
back to back appointments are not treated as a clash
an end before the start is refused before the form can be sent
an existing appointment can be edited without clashing with itself
a company and a contact can be created and linked
a contact with no name is refused with the message on the field
search narrows the list down to the matching contact
an activity logged on a contact appears in its history
deleting a contact asks first and then removes it
a deal moves through the pipeline and disappears once it is won
a negative amount is rejected with the message on the field
an overdue to-do is flagged and can be ticked off
the overview counts what was entered and lists what is overdue
the interface switches to German and stays there after a reload
an administrator adds a user who then has to choose their own password
a bookmarked page opens the application instead of a blank 404
a wrong password is refused and the session stays signed out
signing out returns to the login screen and protects the pages again
